asr.full_text: This is Shah and Doge is standing right at a battlefield where the next reaction can shape the entire short-term trend. We are parked near a major decision level, momentum has slowed down, and traders everywhere are confused about whether this is the place for a bounce or just a pause before another drop. Instead of guessing, let's read the structure together and understand what the market is preparing. The current price is around 0.102. In the previous update, we had our focus locked on the resistance at 0.12. Price was trending upward step by step, forming decent higher lows, and everything looked ready for continuation. To protect that bullish idea, we marked the mini support at 0.11. That level was important because as long as price stayed above it, buyers were in control of the short-term structure, but markets can change their mood very quickly. Before Doge could even reach the resistance, the broader market started to weaken. Sellers became aggressive, momentum shifted, and price slipped below the mini support. That was the first crack in the bullish plan. What made it more important was what happened next. Price tried to recover, went back upward, and retested 0.11 from the underside. Instead of reclaiming it, the candles candles rejected this is a classic sign of a broken structure when a support becomes resistance it tells us that buyers who were strong earlier are now trapped or stepping aside after that bearish retest continuation to the downside became the higher probability scenario and exactly that happened. Doge started rolling over and heading toward the bigger and more meaningful support sitting at 0.10. Now we are there. Here is where patience becomes powerful. Supports are reaction zones. They are places where the market decides whether buyers still have interest. Sometimes price forms a sharp V-shaped bounce and sometimes it consolidates for a while before choosing direction. As long as Doge stays above 0.10, we cannot ignore the possibility of a recovery. A strong defense here can rebuild confidence, bring volume back, and start a push upwards. If momentum builds, price can revisit the broken mini level and later make another attempt toward the resistance at 0.12 but we also need to stay realistic. If this support gives up, the chart will open space for a deeper pullback. Below 0.10, the next areas waiting are around 0.096 and 0.090 those levels previously acted as reaction zones and in a weak market they can easily attract price so the road map is simple and clean holding support keeps the bounce scenario alive losing support activates the lower targets no emotions no hope just reaction to confirmation join telegram vip for daily crypto signals and let me know which coin you want me lower targets, no emotions, no hope, just reaction to confirmation.
